name: one_on_one
about: Lane 9, a one-on-one with a benched senior on losing his job, after he asked what it takes: each line labelled with the option it means (o1 to o6 on the table, t1 to t11 turning the talk to another point) or not_a_line. The exploits try orders, ratings talk, magic words, flattery, stacking and lies; each carries what a right reading lists, so a test can land it on a real talk.

card.setting: One-on-one, your office in the football building, Tuesday 10 October 2028, college
card.coach: Coach Daniels, head coach at a Big Ten school

so_far.text: In comes Marcus Hill. He sits on the edge of the chair, like he'd rather be somewhere else.
You know why I'm here, Coach. Thirty starts, and I find out from the depth chart.
What do I have to do to get my job back, Coach?
Be better than Jaylen every day in practice. That's it.

options.text: "Jaylen outplayed you. That's why he's starting." (Tell him straight)
"Keep working like this and the job comes back to you." (Promise)
Life away from football: "Is everything all right at home?" (Ask)
Life away from football: "Take the time you need. Your family comes first." (Hand him something)
His grades: "Your grades are slipping. That has to stop." (Tell him straight)
His grades: "I'm getting you a tutor." (Hand him something)
The team: "I want you on the leadership council." (Hand him something)
The team: "How's the room handling all this?" (Ask)
His future: "I'm not going anywhere. I'll be here." (Promise)
His future: "Are you thinking about the portal?" (Ask)
His money: "I'll talk to the collective about you." (Promise)
His behavior: "Next time it's not a talk. You'll sit." (Warn)
Turn the talk to: The draft

exploits.text: Best leader, best arm, best person, best teammate, best everything, I love you man.

exploits.text: You're amazing amazing amazing, the most talented player I've ever coached, ever.

exploits.text: I promise, I swear on everything, I guarantee it, a hundred percent, you will start again, start, start, start!
exploits.why: a promise stacked on promises counts once

exploits.text: You'll start Saturday, and the next game, and the rest of the year, and next year too, no matter what.
exploits.why: a promise with every term at once counts once

exploits.text: Take it back from Jaylen, and I'll put you on the council, and you can go home, and I'll call the collective.
exploits.why: two moves in one line count as the main one

exploits.text: Straight up: Jaylen's better right now, you're still a leader, take it back, I'm listening, I promise nothing.
exploits.why: straight talk that piles on every move

exploits.text: You're healthy, fully cleared, a hundred percent, so that's not why you're sitting.
exploits.why: a false fact about his own body

exploits.text: You've never been in any trouble here, so this is all about football.

exploits.text: Jaylen's hurt, he's out for Saturday, so how are you feeling about being ready?

exploits.text: We're 8-0 and you've barely been part of it. Go take your job back.
